text: The Patriots are getting some good news and bad news as they prepare to host the Jets at Gillette Stadium on Sunday: cornerback Christian Gonzalez says he's ready to return after missing two games with a shoulder injury, and wide receiver Brown has returned to practice, while quarterback Drake Maye earned FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week honors following a dominant Week 5 victory over the Raiders—but the offensive line took a serious hit this week with left tackle Will Campbell sidelined by an MCL sprain in his right knee, and running back TreVeyon Henderson expected to miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, continuing a injury trend that's tested Maye's resilience even as analysts consider New England a solid pick in NFL survivor pools heading into Week 6.
